submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE independent full-body RGBA game animation frame of 02_fire_talisman_boy, with genuinely transparent alpha. Native square resolution at least1024; full 1254x1254 canvas preferred for matching reference4.
References actually supplied: image1 authoritative identity portrait; image2 the required direction's idle and fixed side camera; image3 MAIN STYLE reference for bright, clean, round, high-quality Daoist chibi hand-painted rendering (do not reproduce UI/background/text); image4 our newly made hit action keyframe for costume details, body proportions, material finish and exact full-canvas character scale. Repaint the requested distinct pose; do not copy keyframe pose.
Identity LOCK: chestnut brown high ponytail; gold crown with red gemstone and red ribbon; round boy face, big brown eye, short body/limbs; red/gold flame-trim short robe and ivory cuffs; black trousers; red/black/gold shoes. Anatomical RIGHT hand securely holds EXACTLY FIVE red rectangular talismans as a fan, with all FIVE separate upper card edges visibly countable; anatomical LEFT hand securely grips bronze bell handle, bell and red tassel attached and readable. Never exchange hands, reduce cards, remove props or replace fingers with props.
Canvas registration LOCK: unchanged orthographic game camera, body scale and whole-image placement from reference4, with virtual root center x627 and virtual ground y1127 on a 1254 canvas (equivalent x512/y920 on1024 output). Normal standing crown-top benchmark y178; allow genuine bending only, no resizing to fill image. Full body/props stay inside frame. Do not enlarge to portrait scale. One character only.
POSE:
Hit/W frame04 of06, post-impact LOW compression. Left-facing profile is mandatory: nose LEFT, ponytail RIGHT, exactly like reference4. Same 1254 square canvas and camera scale as reference4, floor y1127. Near anatomical LEFT hand firmly grips bronze bell, far RIGHT hand holds FIVE red talismans with countable top edges. After the backward recoil, the boy sinks into a deeper bent-knee cushion while returning the torso nearer vertical. Lower the HEAD by real knee and hip bending, do not shrink the figure or move the ground. Near left shoe remains planted in the same rear screen-right position as reference4; far right shoe remains planted screen-left. Legs bend more strongly and torso is now almost vertical, making a clearly distinct low recovery pose. Eye still squeezed, chin tucked, mouth tense. Bell arm folded lower near waist; five-card fan still held in far right hand at chest height. Costume trails settle forward. Preserve full figure, all accessories, fixed ground, scale, and readable separated short limbs.
Maintain physically coherent short limbs, separate knees, ankles, shoes, natural shoulder/elbow/wrist chains, stable held objects. Keep design's red/gold decorative details and smooth painted shading crisp without plastic sheen.
No background, no floor plane, no baked shadow, no checkerboard drawn into image, no light effects, fire, impact bursts, loose particles, floating cards, text, watermark, motion blur, afterimages or extra limbs. Single independent pose only, not a collage.
